clauses.clause: for a card named Basri, Devoted Paladin, reveal it, and put it into your hand
clauses.evidence: The probe zones hold no Paladin. Pack P79cfec2ff7_aegis_library_only.json (option 1: Paladin library -> hand; with two targets, mine and the opponent's, each gets exactly one counter). Pack P79cfec2ff7_aegis_graveyard_only_no_shuffle.json (option 2: Paladin graveyard -> hand; the target becomes 2/2 with one counter). Pack P79cfec2ff7_aegis_both_zones_one_card.json (option 0, one Paladin in each zone, no target: the one_of offers both, exactly one comes to hand and the other stays in the library). All PASS. Tree: SEARCH count 1 NAME_EQ 'Basri, Devoted Paladin' -> your hand.
clauses.issue: The REVEAL count=1 idiom reveals the library's top card (card:9 / 10 / 11 in the pack runs), not the Paladin found. Information only (nothing reads REVEAL events). With one candidate the search auto-picks it and offers no 'find nothing'; that is never stronger.
